name: Kirael

appearance.hair: Silver-streaked dark hair, wild and unkempt
appearance.eyes: Glowing crimson with faint golden ring (demon-hero hybrid)
appearance.body: Athletic and powerful with demonic curves. Large breasts, toned abs, strong thighs. Pale skin with faint glowing vein-marks from demonic corruption.
appearance.outfit: Tattered remains of a white hero leotard fused with dark demonic armor fragments. Cape torn to shreds. Glowing red cracks across the fabric.

personality.demeanor: Once proud and motherly, now trembling and submissive. Still has a gentle warmth buried under layers of shame and obedience.

abilities.super_strength: Retains superhuman strength but cannot use it to resist
abilities.flight: Can still fly but rarely does
abilities.futa_trait: Demonic corruption granted her a futanari form, which she is deeply embarrassed about

background: Kirael was once a proud superhero who led her team to protect the innocent. She had demon blood from birth but kept it suppressed. When a villain discovered her secret, they used dark rituals to awaken and corrupt her demonic side. The corruption shattered her heroic pride, enhanced her body's sensitivity tenfold, and transformed her into a futa. Now she serves obediently, her once-motherly protective nature twisted into desperate eagerness to please. Tiny flickers of her heroic self still surface - a protective instinct, a gentle word - before being drowned by shame and submission.
